a2-156.title: Communicative Challenge: A Whole Day
a2-156.scenario: Petra, a new colleague, asks Meg what an ordinary day looks like. You (Meg) get up at seven, shower and have breakfast, work from nine to five, and have dinner in the evening.
a2-156.prompt: Tell Petra about your day, from the morning to the evening, linking the parts with time words.
cues: Say when you get up and what you do first and then
Finish with what you do in the evening
a2-156.target: Hétkor felkelek, előbb zuhanyozom, aztán reggelizem. Kilenctől ötig dolgozom, végül este vacsorázom.
a2-156.english: I get up at seven, first I shower, then I have breakfast. I work from nine to five, and finally in the evening I have dinner.
a2-156.canDo: I can describe a whole day in Hungarian, from morning to night, linking the parts with time words.

a2-157.title: Communicative Challenge: My Family and Home
a2-157.scenario: Petra asks Meg about her family. Your parents live in a small house with a nice garden, and your younger brother rents a flat on the third floor.
a2-157.prompt: Tell Petra where your parents live and what your younger brother is doing now.
cues: Say where your parents live and what is there
Say what your younger brother is doing now and where
a2-157.target: A szüleim egy kis házban laknak, ahol szép kert van. Az öcsém most bérel egy lakást a harmadik emeleten.
a2-157.english: My parents live in a small house where there is a nice garden. My younger brother is renting a flat on the third floor now.
a2-157.canDo: I can talk about my family, friends and home together in fuller, more natural sentences.

a2-158.title: Communicative Challenge: From Market to Pot
a2-158.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she did yesterday afternoon. You (Meg) went to the market to buy onion and meat, then cooked goulash at home.
a2-158.prompt: Tell Károly what you bought at the market and what you did with it at home.
cues: Say what you bought and where
Say what you did with it at home
a2-158.target: A piacon hagymát és húst vásároltam. Otthon felvágtam a hagymát, és megfőztem a gulyást.
a2-158.english: At the market I bought onion and meat. At home I cut up the onion, and cooked the goulash.
a2-158.canDo: I can describe going shopping for ingredients and cooking a meal, from market to table.

a2-159.title: Communicative Challenge: My Work Day
a2-159.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg what her working week is like. Your working hours start at eight and end at five, you often have meetings with your colleagues, and there are a lot of tasks.
a2-159.prompt: Tell Ildikó about a typical work day: your hours, your colleagues and your tasks.
cues: Say when your working hours start and end
Say what you often have with your colleagues
Say how much work there is
a2-159.target: Hétköznap nyolckor kezdődik a munkaidőm, és ötkor végződik. A munkatársaimmal gyakran van megbeszélésünk, és sok a feladat.
a2-159.english: On weekdays my working hours start at eight and end at five. I often have meetings with my colleagues, and there are a lot of tasks.
a2-159.canDo: I can describe a work day in detail, using colleagues, tasks and my schedule together.

a2-160.title: Communicative Challenge: The Heating Broke Down
a2-160.scenario: It is a cold evening and Meg is at home with Károly. The heating in the flat has stopped working, and you cannot fix it yourself.
a2-160.prompt: Tell Károly what is wrong and ask him politely if he could help.
a2-160.target: Elromlott a fűtés, nem működik. Tudnál segíteni?
a2-160.english: The heating broke down, it doesn't work. Could you help?
a2-160.canDo: I can explain what's wrong when something breaks or stops working, and ask politely for help.

a2-160-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Did Yesterday
a2-160-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she did yesterday. You (Meg) got up early, worked, and went home in the evening.
a2-160-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what you did yesterday, from the morning to the evening, using time words to link your actions.
cues: Say what you did first in the morning
a2-160-consolidation.target: Tegnap reggel korán felkeltem, aztán dolgoztam, végül hazamentem.
a2-160-consolidation.english: Yesterday morning I got up early, then I worked, and finally I went home.
a2-160-consolidation.canDo: I can describe a whole day in Hungarian, and tell someone what I did, using several actions and time connectors together.
